التقطوا (form VIII)

# اُلْتُقِطُوا (ultuqiṭū) /ul.tu.qi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# اِلْتَقِطُوا (iltaqiṭū) /il.ta.qi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
